notes.title: Etheriia - Travelogue - Chapter 2 - Evelyn's Secret
notes.content:
Hey, Travelers
If you thought you had seen it all, get ready: half of our next chapter is already complete, and the title alone — [i]Evelyn’s Secret[/i] — says a lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/6909d1fd8b10a9b9b50a65106f974d65520394d2.png[/img]

What secrets does this witch hide so deeply that not even Aerith (me, of course!) can decipher?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/5f3d6ac4cad19858ea7addf63a51d323e657810a.jpg[/img]

This chapter promises to be far bolder: a classic-style visual novel interspersed with cinematic scenes, sensual animations, and breathtaking moments.
And don’t think it’s just reading...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/37f66aed2d3dffa1d8a6a9d3297b69fb369cdf05.jpg[/img]

You’ll interact with exclusive minigames that make [i]Evelyn’s Secret[/i] even more dynamic and immersive.
Agility challenges, mouse interactions like drag-and-drop with objects in the scene, and... an alchemy workshop where you’ll brew potions directly with Evelyn.
Just be careful: mixing the wrong ingredients might make the potion — or you — much more... unstable than expected. 

Get ready. Evelyn doesn’t like people messing with her stuff... but she never resists a good provocation.
And speaking of that...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/3163d8566a9dc6eea1b176d4d5a0a1e6cccb62ef.jpg[/img]

There’s tension in the air... and maybe, just maybe, it’ll explode into something much more carnal.
But don’t get too excited... or maybe do?

And as if Evelyn weren’t trouble enough... this chapter also begins the arc of [b]Iris[/b], the goddess of pleasure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/e3a6e6d7fdd6278034c4b6f1d235771ebd07c0c2.jpg[/img]

A being as seductive as she is dangerous, who runs a casino where everything is allowed — and nothing is forgiven.
What starts as an innocent visit may end in a game of desires you weren’t prepared to play.

Iris’s presence marks a major turning point in the story, where pleasure becomes a weapon, and the rules... well, they simply don’t exist.
Are you ready to wager your memories for a moment of ecstasy?

Don’t forget to download the Etheriia - Travelogue - Chapter 1 demo: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3583230/EtheriiA__Travelogue_Demo/

More than 1500 people downloaded it in under 30 days — and that makes our universe so happy.
By playing the demo, you can contribute with your comments and suggestions for improvement.

Oh, and a hot tip: this episode will be available separately on our Patreon.
https://www.patreon.com/c/axiagamestudio

If you want early access, exclusive materials, and weekly updates with screenshots and new animations, this is your chance to join us!

Your support is what keeps this universe alive — and delightfully chaotic.
If you’ve already joined us on this journey, thank you! If not... what are you waiting for?

Add [b]Etheriia - Travelogue[/b] to your wishlist on Steam: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2854640/EtheriiA__Travelogue/

Invite your friends, and become part of our interdimensional community.
Every click, every piece of feedback, and every Patreon supporter helps us make this project even more amazing!

With love, unstable portals, and a little bit of reckless magic,
[i]Aerith[/i]

notes.title: Luna: A Thief with Style (and Problems to Solve)
notes.content:
[b]Hey, travelers![/b]

    Ah, yes, let me introduce you to [i]Luna[/i], the queen of efficiency, elegant stealth and serious expressions. But don't be fooled by her impeccable posture and those piercing red eyes that seem to already know all your secrets. This elegant thief has more layers than a shattered multiverse - and believe me, I would know. I destroyed it.

    We met on one of those days that started with “this will be easy” and ended with “run for your life”. Of course, I was the one who convinced her to leave the monotony of her [i]perfect[/i] robes for something... bigger. (Bigger than what she had in her mouth with Warrior, but let's not be vulgar here... or should we? I don't know anymore.)

    I can't help laughing every time Warrior moves - it's as if someone has taught him how to have sex by reading an instruction manual.
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/18eb07e158c22766790a96ba6aa02b0ba1d67091.gif[/img]

    We begin with the theft of a sacred chalice, conveniently hidden in a museum full of traps (and rats).
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/f664e41f76363742fbd7d699834325ca05fd3371.gif[/img]

    To sum up the story? We got the chalice, but not without a good dose of chaos.
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/7297fa34a381b05ae391911c9faea355f831845a.png[/img]

    Luna is exactly the kind of person you want by your side on a suicide mission. She calculates everything - from the safest route to the chances of someone being killed - and is usually [i]right[/i]. That's annoying. Not because she's always one step ahead, but because she makes it look easy. Am I jealous? Maybe. Would I admit it? Not at all.

    [b]But she also has a more... human side.[/b] When exhaustion catches up with her or things get out of hand (which is rare, but happens when she's with me), she reveals a sensitive and vulnerable side that Honestly catches me off guard. It's in those moments that I realize that, behind all that seriousness, there's someone who needs affection as much as I need a decent plan from time to time.

    And it's in those moments that I catch her. Not to take advantage, of course, but because she's not easy for anyone - and she definitely won't be for you if your decisions are just as confusing.
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/61cdfd5ce5debceb2ae478db19e8f596771366d6.gif[/img]

    It wasn't easy for Warrior either. Honestly, I still don't know what she saw in him apart from the muscles and... well, let's say his “sword” isn't just metaphorical. Yeah, that's probably it.

    Oh, and one last thing: she's jealous of Evelyn. She doesn't think anyone notices, but I do. And I find that hilarious, of course, because everyone wants Evelyn, and Evelyn doesn't care about anyone. It's a fun dynamic... for me.

    That said, Luna is [b]the perfect partner for diving into (and out of) chaos[/b]. If you think you can keep up with her, [i]good luck[/i]. Don't say I didn't warn you.

    [b]Add Etheriia - Travelogue to your wishlist now[/b] and meet Luna, the thief with more style, courage and problems than you can imagine.

notes.title: Evelyn Can Be Your Wish or Your Ruin... Which Do You Choose?
notes.content:
[b]Hey, traveler![/b]

Let me ask you: are you ready to [i]feel[/i] something you've never felt before?

Meet Evelyn, the embodiment of mystery and temptation.

This isn't just any witch here—she's an enigma wrapped in seduction,
and every moment with her is an invitation to the unknown. Or danger.

Or maybe both, depending on how you play your cards.

Think you know what intimacy is? Well, Evelyn redefines that.

Earning her trust isn't easy, but if you do, what she offers behind closed doors
is something that will leave a mark on you—and I'm not talking about scars (or maybe I am).

[i]"Whoever earns my trust gains the privilege of seeing a side of me that few have dared to dream of."[/i]

That's what she once told me. And yes, I was tempted. Who wouldn't?

Between you and me, traveler, I've always wanted to understand Evelyn's secrets... up close.

But for some reason, she seems... a little [i]distrustful of me[/i].

Maybe it's because I, Aerith, am irresistibly fabulous?

Or maybe because I threatened the order of the universe and that may have hurt her? Who knows?

Until then, all I can do is hope that [b]you[/b] achieves something that I haven't yet.

Make a connection, have that private moment with her, find out what happens when that witchy outfit falls off

and that gorgeous body is right in front of you.

Oh, and if you're wondering what could happen alone with Evelyn... picture this:

the dimly lit room, her gaze fixed on yours, and every word filled with promises.

Or maybe threats. With Evelyn, you never know.

What I can guarantee is that every second will leave your skin crawling – whether from desire or fear.

Now, a warning: play with her heart, and she might play with your life.

And Evelyn is [i]very[/i] good at playing, especially when there's poison involved.

But if she chooses you... if she deems you worthy... the reward will be something no one else in the universe could offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/44f6e208a083e7b1ba71f9a7c4d80d1f2005c2ac.jpg[/img]

[b]Add Etheriia - Travelogue to your wishlist[/b] and come explore Evelyn's universe of temptation and secrets. She's waiting - 
not for just anyone, but for someone who can play her games and, perhaps, win her heart. 
Do you think you're up to it? 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2854640/EtheriiA__Travelogue/

[b]See you at the portal,[/b]
Aerith - the fabulous (if you find out what Evelyn is hiding under her dress, will you tell me?).

notes.title: Hey, Travelers!
notes.content:
[b]Hey, Travelers![/b]

    Exploring different dimensions means you’ll get a taste of everything – including things you never imagined before.  
    And of all the flavors out there, there’s one you’ll never forget – her name is [i]Evelyn[/i].  
    Did you think I was talking about ice cream? You know better than that!  

    [i]Evelyn[/i] is a witch!  
    Old? With a big nose and a pointy hat?  
    Well, she does have a witch’s hat – gotta respect some traditions, right? But beyond that, Evelyn is nothing like the cliché. Forget flying brooms and wart-covered skin.  

    Evelyn is… [i]irresistible[/i]. Two emerald-green eyes that seem to scan your soul. A figure that’s pure magic – curves in all the right places and a confidence that could make even the bravest faller (I love the word, [i]MAGIC[/i]).  

    She’s the one behind the mysterious fluids that help regenerate my dimensional key. You'll need to win her over if you want to earn one of her potions (and yes, potions are sooo witchy).  

    Honestly, I envy you. If you make the right choices, you could unlock the highest level of intimacy with her – something I've never managed to do (tears).  
    But you? I believe in you.  

    Evelyn is still getting her final touches – let’s just say I wanted her to be absolutely perfect (I don’t usually obsess over details, but she’s going to be [i]breathtaking[/i]). Trust me, once she's revealed tomorrow, you'll understand why her name will be unforgettable.  
    
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/1f3d9b8a3e56af595bf1329b89a1e08f509e9ea2.jpg[/img]

    So, Travelers, get ready. Tomorrow is the day Evelyn steps onto the stage of [b]Etheriia[/b]. You won't want to miss a second of it.  

    [b]See you tomorrow (and try not to lose your breath),[/b]  
    [i]Aerith (and AxiaGameStudio)[/i]

notes.title: Organize Dimensions? Only with Chaos and Adventures!
notes.content:
[b]Hey, Travelers![/b]

Have you ever tried to organize a universe so orderly that even a line of ants would look like a mess next to it? Well, that's my life. Between cute elves with their [i]*eternal*[/i] meditations and medieval warriors sweating buckets inside armor that looks like portable ovens ([i]seriously, it must be hell in there[/i]), I keep asking myself: [i]why do I keep doing this anyway?[/i]

Oh, and the barbarians? Always so fierce, full of strength, screaming as if they had tripped over a LEGO piece... only to end up hitting a tree trunk with an axe thinking it was a monster. [i]The art of barbarian warfare is, to say the least, peculiar.[/i]

And the 2D worlds? Explain to me how this is possible! How am I supposed to know if someone is facing me from the front or from the side? They are so thin that if they spin too fast, they might disappear! If they are supposed to confuse a goddess, these universes are doing an excellent job.

That is why I am always looking for new adventures, new worlds. The truth is that no one understands the beauty and mystery of these dimensions better than Luna. She has a special vision, a way of seeing beyond the obvious. While I get lost trying to understand the rules of these crazy realities, Luna always seems to know exactly where to go – even if the path involves a sewer tunnel ([i]why always sewer, Luna?![/i]).

So, if you're ready to escape the boredom of perfection or want to find out what Luna knows ([i]because I haven't figured it all out yet, and I'm a goddess[/i]), [b]add Etheriia - Travelogue to your wishlist right now[/b]. Together, we'll explore dimensions where nothing makes sense, but everything is possible. And who knows, maybe one day I'll finally understand what it's like to live in 2D without looking like a sheet of paper.

**[b]See you soon[/b] ([i]probably in a sewer, but at least it'll be exciting[/i]),** 
[b]Aerith (and AxiaGameStudio)[/b]

notes.title: Museum Mission: Glamour? No, just sewage.
notes.content:
Hey, travelers!

Have you ever heard of "godly glamour"? Well, forget it. I'm going to tell you a story that will make anyone rethink their life decisions (and maybe their choice of partners in crime, but who's counting, right?).

Picture this: Luna, always the brilliant strategist, says: "The best way to get to the museum is through the sewers." And me? Like the fabulous and incredibly perceptive goddess that I am, I obviously agreed without question (I'm lying, I questioned a lot, but she's very convincing).

Now, imagine: me, Aerith, all powerful, walking among rats who clearly had no idea who I was. It was like a fashion show, except the theme was "post-apocalyptic sewers." Total glamour. Every step brought a new surprise: an indescribable odor here, a slippery slime there, and let's not forget the little "creepy friends" who decided to accompany us. Luna, of course, was in front, analyzing every corner as if it were normal. "Just one more tunnel, Aerith," she said. Yeah, sure...

After a lot of "liquid adventure" (if you know what I mean), we finally reached the underground garage. I won't go into details, but let's just say we made it, despite everything. Oh, and then what? Yes, my friends, the cherry on the cake: we went back the same way. Yes, because why not repeat the suffering? Double the fun, right?

And the best part? You won't see any of this in the game. Because, let's face it, no one wants to see a goddess at her least glamorous. But now that you know, add Etheriia - Travelogue to your wish list, because if I had to go through this, the least you can do is come with me.

See you soon (hopefully in a spa and not in another sewer),
Aerith (and AxiaGameStudio)

notes.title: Luna invites you on a heist and mystery adventure!
notes.content:
[b]Hey, Travelers![/b] 

Oh, look who decided to come through the [i]Dimensional Portal[/i]. Let me get you up to speed real quick: this is a hot mess. And I mean a [i]real[/i] hot mess. The perfect universe we once knew? Now filled with bugs so bad they look like they came straight out of a cheap 3D asset store. But hey, I'm a goddess, so fixing catastrophes like this is my job. And guess what? I'm generous enough to let you join me on this one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/fe462d740acb264e93560e6d8f35207b02668089.gif[/img]

Join me in this interdimensional blaze with Luna, a thief so clever I have to admit she's impressive (and I don't hand out compliments easily). We started in the [i]most glamorous[/i] place of all: her bathroom. Yeah, that's where the master plan was hatched. Who would've thought that cheap soap and bad lighting could inspire something so brilliant?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/9e1980a5b8955914b9aee98c924835ed6c7f7fad.jpg[/img]

The big heist? It happened in a museum full of ancient relics – and had more traps than a bad action movie. We dodged lasers, almost died (multiple times), and escaped with some shiny, dimension-saving loot. Barely. Then we headed straight into a creepy underground tunnel where – surprise, surprise – a mysterious figure showed up. Did they help? Not at all. Thanks for nothing, mysterious stranger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/f04958d714c73d816a75a237ed2a96a12e48bf8d.gif[/img]

After all this chaos, Luna decided to unwind with a bath. Yeah, you needed to know that. Why? Because it’s Luna, and she deserves to be in the spotlight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/7be44f60bc0d3a70936db4fc82d27ecfa2dc6f16.gif[/img]

Meanwhile, there might have been a little... romantic tension between us. Let's just say the chemistry was [i]palpable[/i]. (But never ask me to admit that again, okay?)

And then there’s the Warrior. Oh, he’s back. But not to help – he wants something back that Luna "borrowed" (read: stole).

Of course, everything went wrong, and we had to run back to the [i]Dimensional Portal[/i]. That's when we realized: the universe is collapsing, and time is running out. And guess who’s responsible for fixing it? That's right, [b]you[/b], Traveler. No pressure.

It’s up to you to guide me, Luna, and the Warrior through this chaos. Every choice you make has consequences – big ones. You could save the universe... or destroy it. And the romance? Trust me, you’ll enjoy it. Ever dated an elf? I have. And trust me, you’ll want to. (Don’t worry, I’m not judging. Much.) Plus, there are thieves, badass warriors, and some [i]really[/i] unexpected encounters that might blow your mind.

So, what are you waiting for? [b]Add Etheriia - Travelogue to your wishlist[/b] and get ready for the wildest, most chaotic, and seductive adventure of your life. Don’t forget to thank me later. You’re welcome.

[b]See you soon,[/b]  
Aerith (and AxiaGameStudio)

We have [b]medieval worlds[/b] with legendary battles and [b]sci-fi settings[/b] featuring technology beyond imagination.

But then, everything changes. Robots and elves find themselves sharing dimensions, and romances begin to bloom between 3D characters and 2D figures. [i]The portal between dimensions seems to have lost control[/i], and chaos ensues.

notes.title: Supporter Edition Announcement - Join Us from the Start!
notes.content:
[b]Hey, Travelers![/b]  

We have important news about [i]Etheriia - Travelogue[/i], and we’d like to share this decision with you and hear your thoughts about this next step.

After much thought on the best way to make the project sustainable, we’ve decided to release the [b]first episode[/b] as a supporter version – or [i]Supporter Edition[/i] – for only [b]$1.99[/b]. This episode will have approximately [b]40 to 50 minutes of gameplay[/b] and will be an introduction to the world of [i]Etheriia[/i], where you'll meet Aerith, Luna, and the Warrior and begin to uncover the mysteries that surround them.

[b]Why did we make this choice?[/b]

Our main reason is the desire to [b]build an engaged community from the start[/b] while seeking financial support to develop the upcoming episodes. By setting an accessible price of $1.99, we want everyone to get involved in the project and help bring the world of [i]Etheriia[/i] to life.

Our plan is to release episodes 2 and 3 in September 2025 as a paid update for new players. However, supporters who purchase this initial version for $1.99 will [b]receive free access to the next episodes[/b] as a thank you for supporting us from the start.

We know this is an unusual approach, so we want to be fully transparent: every purchase of this supporter version will help us improve the game, add content, and reach the level of quality we want to offer you.

[b]We want to hear from you![/b]

Do you think this idea is fair? Do you agree with the symbolic price of $1.99? Would you pay this amount to help bring [i]Etheriia[/i] to life?

Your involvement as supporters and as a community is essential to us. If you have any suggestions or questions, please share them in the comments. Together, we can create something special.

[b]See you soon,[/b]
